rule: Cite ONLY claims with citable=true. Every Zoho endpoint, path, method and OAuth scope must come from zoho_endpoint_inventory.json, which is machine-generated from the vendor's own OpenAPI bundle. Anything not in these files must be written as 'UNVERIFIED - REQUIRES ZOHO CONFIRMATION'.
hard_negatives: Purchase Request does not exist anywhere in the official ERP API specification
The GRN leg of line-level matching is broken; the PO-to-bill leg is intact
There is no API to CREATE a custom field definition; only to set values on a record
Fixed assets cannot be linked to a source project, PO or bill, and cannot be incrementally synced
